intro: Lydon's Toxin is an alchemical concoction synthesized by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill to disrupt the Venture Company's deforestation in the Stonetalon Mountains. Entrusted to Horde adventurers, it is delivered to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff so she can devise an effective delivery mechanism.

p: Developed by Apothecary Lydon in the Hillsbrad Foothills, this virulent compound is designed to combat the invasive Venture Company loggers despoiling the Stonetalon Mountains. According to Lydon, the concoction produces lethal and potentially contagious results upon contact. However, before the substance can be unleashed against the goblins' operations around the Windshear Crag, it must be ferried across continents to Apothecary Zamah, the Royal Apothecary Society's representative in Thunder Bluff. Zamah requires the raw mixture to engineer a wide-dispersal apparatus—the Toxic Fogger—ensuring the brew wipes out the exploitative deforesters without needlessly endangering Horde assets.
